children: Healing, the way it has been done for centuries
A calm clinic for acupuncture, cupping and herbal medicine — traditional Chinese medicine, practised with patience and care.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every treatment is with a board-certified, state-licensed acupuncturist — trained for years in both needle work and herbal medicine.
We practise classical Chinese medicine as it was taught: reading the whole person, not just the symptom in front of us.
Where herbs will help, we build a formula for your constitution — nothing off a shelf, everything made to fit you.
Warm rooms, quiet music and unhurried appointments. You’re here to slow down, and the space is built for it.

children: Traditional Chinese medicine sees the body as one connected system — the five elements in balance. Pain, poor sleep, low energy and stress are rarely separate problems; they’re signs of where that balance has slipped.
So we don’t chase a single symptom. We read your pulse, look and listen, and treat the pattern underneath — gently, over time, so the results hold.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Five Elements Acupuncture is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A serene treatment room with warm wood, soft light and a made-up table

children: We opened Five Elements to practise Chinese medicine the way it was meant to be practised — unhurried, personal, and rooted in a tradition thousands of years old.
No rushing, no one-size-fits-all. Just careful diagnosis, treatment tailored to you, and a calm space to heal in — for pain, stress, sleep, fertility and everything in between.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every course of care begins with a real intake — your history, your pulse, your tongue — so the treatment fits the person, not the label.
Fine, single-use needles and high-grade herbs sourced from suppliers we know — with honest advice on what will and won’t help.
We plan treatment over time and tell you what to expect, so each visit builds on the last toward a result that lasts.
